highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a research-driven university in the USA? The University of Akron is a great choice. It’s a public institution offering over 200 undergraduate majors, minors, and certificates across Engineering, Arts & Sciences, Business, Health Sciences, Law, and more. You’ll find that the university is ranked 1st in the nation for Polymer Science and Plastics Engineering.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: With over 300 student organisations and clubs, you’ll have many opportunities to meet new people. You can also engage in varsity and club sports, and civic-engagement programmes like serveAkron.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Akron offers you a variety of modern accommodation options. Here, first-year students are required to live on campus unless exempted.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university library offers you extensive resources for your studies, including books, journals, and digital materials.

Sports
You’ll find cardio/strength equipment, gyms, rock-climbing walls, and an Olympic-size pool at the Student Recreation & Wellness Centre. There’s also the Ocasek Natatorium with aquatics, while intramurals, club sports, and outdoor adventure programs complete the wellness offerings.

Laboratory
Engineering and science students benefit from expert-designed labs and research equipment.

Cafeteria
You’ll find many eateries with study lounges at the Student Union. Plus, the dining halls in the residence areas also offer flexible meal plans.
